title: REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST (CONSULTING SERVICES– FIRMS SELECTION)
description: REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST (CONSULTING SERVICES– FIRMS SELECTION) The African Union has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Africa Centres for Disease Control Support Program to Combat Current and Future Public Health Threats Project. The Project Development Objective is to enhance the capacity of Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) to support AU Member States in preventing, detecting, and responding to current and future public health threats and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC), an autonomous institution of the African Union, is mandated to strengthen public health systems across Africa through coordinated disease prevention, preparedness, and response. In line with this mandate, Africa CDC is establishing Five (5) Regional Coordinating Centres (RCCs), including the Eastern Africa RCC. On 27 April 2025, a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) was signed between the Government of Kenya and Africa CDC, under which the Government of Kenya allocated 10 acres of land for the establishment of the Eastern Africa Regional Coordinating Office and Regional Training Centre. The proposed EARCC Hub will involve ground-clearing, earthworks, civil construction, installation of utilities (water, electricity, sanitation, medical waste systems), and fit-out of specialized laboratory and emergency operations facilities.
